title: S1 · Cliente: sprint con stamina, HUD wiring y brújula
request: Sprint 1, comando 8/8 (Plan §6, re-numerado tras fusionar 24+25). LocalScript del cliente: sprint con stamina (LeftShift) multiplicado por D60_SpeedMultiplier del servidor, wiring de DeliveryEvent al HUD, cuenta atrás local, brújula con distancia al destino y barra de estabilidad vía D60_Stability. Ejecutar después de cmd_000025.

operations.source:
-- Delivery60Client · Sprint con stamina, HUD wiring y brújula de destino (S1).
-- El servidor (DeliveryService) es la autoridad del estado; el cliente muestra y mueve.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Root = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Delivery60")
local Config = require(Root.Data:WaitForChild("Config"))
local PackageTypes = require(Root.Data:WaitForChild("PackageTypes"))
local DeliveryEvent = Root.Remotes:WaitForChild("DeliveryEvent")
local gui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("Delivery60HUD")

local timerLabel = gui:WaitForChild("TimerLabel")
local card = gui:WaitForChild("PackageCard")
local cardIcon = card:WaitForChild("CardIcon")
local cardTitle = card:WaitForChild("CardTitle")
local cardModifier = card:WaitForChild("CardModifier")
local cardDestination = card:WaitForChild("CardDestination")
local arrow = gui:WaitForChild("DestinationArrow")
local stabBar = gui:WaitForChild("StabilityBar")
local stabFill = stabBar:WaitForChild("Fill")
local resultPanel = gui:WaitForChild("ResultPanel")
local resultTitle = resultPanel:WaitForChild("ResultTitle")
local resultBreakdown = resultPanel:WaitForChild("ResultBreakdown")
local resultCoins = resultPanel:WaitForChild("ResultCoins")
local coinsLabel = gui:WaitForChild("CoinsLabel")

local STABILITY_MAX = 100 -- display: debe coincidir con Explosive.StabilityMax (Modifiers/Explosive)

-- ==== Sprint con stamina (GDD §10) ====
-- Velocidad final = base (walk/sprint) x D60_SpeedMultiplier (lo fija el servidor:
-- así Heavy frena también el sprint sin que dos scripts peleen por WalkSpeed).
local stamina = Config.StaminaMax
local sprinting = false

local function humanoid()
	local char = player.Character
	return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then
		return
	end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		sprinting = true
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		sprinting = false
	end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local hum = humanoid()
	if not hum then
		return
	end
	local mult = player.Character and player.Character:GetAttribute("D60_SpeedMultiplier") or 1
	local moving = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
	if sprinting and moving and stamina > 0 then
		stamina = math.max(0, stamina - Config.StaminaDrainPerSecond * dt)
		hum.WalkSpeed = Config.SprintSpeed * mult
	else
		stamina = math.min(Config.StaminaMax, stamina + Config.StaminaRegenPerSecond * dt)
		hum.WalkSpeed = Config.WalkSpeed * mult
	end
end)

-- ==== Estado de entrega en HUD ====
local timerEndsAt = nil
local activeDestinationId = nil
local activeDestinationName = nil

DeliveryEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(action, payload)
	if action == "REVEAL" then
		activeDestinationId = payload.destinationId
		activeDestinationName = payload.destinationName
		timerEndsAt = os.clock() + payload.duration
		local pt = PackageTypes[payload.packageType]
		cardIcon.Text = (pt and pt.icon) or "📦"
		cardTitle.Text = ("PACKAGE #%d · %s"):format(payload.id, payload.packageType)
		local mods = table.concat(payload.modifiers, " + ")
		cardModifier.Text = mods ~= "" and mods or "Sin modificadores"
		cardDestination.Text = "📍 " .. tostring(payload.destinationName)
		resultPanel.Visible = false
		card.Visible = true
		timerLabel.Visible = true
		arrow.Visible = true
	elseif action == "COMPLETE" then
		timerEndsAt = nil
		activeDestinationId = nil
		card.Visible = false
		timerLabel.Visible = false
		arrow.Visible = false
		stabBar.Visible = false
		local b = payload.breakdown
		resultTitle.Text = payload.perfect and "⭐ PERFECT DELIVERY" or "✅ DELIVERY COMPLETE"
		resultBreakdown.Text = ("Base %d · Speed %d · Perfect %d"):format(b.base, b.speed, b.perfect)
		resultCoins.Text = ("TOTAL +%d   🪙 %d"):format(b.total, payload.coins)
		coinsLabel.Text = "🪙 " .. tostring(payload.coins)
		resultPanel.Visible = true
		task.delay(4, function()
			resultPanel.Visible = false
		end)
	elseif action == "FAILED" then
		timerEndsAt = nil
		activeDestinationId = nil
		card.Visible = false
		timerLabel.Visible = false
		arrow.Visible = false
		stabBar.Visible = false
		resultTitle.Text = "❌ DELIVERY FAILED · " .. tostring(payload.reason)
		resultBreakdown.Text = "Consolación +" .. tostring(Config.ConsolationPay) .. " · la siguiente sale ya"
		resultCoins.Text = "🪙 " .. tostring(payload.coins)
		coinsLabel.Text = "🪙 " .. tostring(payload.coins)
		resultPanel.Visible = true
		task.delay(4, function()
			resultPanel.Visible = false
		end)
	end
end)

-- ==== Timer, brújula y barra de estabilidad ====
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if timerEndsAt then
		local left = math.max(0, timerEndsAt - os.clock())
		timerLabel.Text = tostring(math.ceil(left))
		if left <= 10 then
			timerLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 80)
		else
			timerLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		end
	end
	if activeDestinationId then
		local char = player.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local city = workspace:FindFirstChild("Delivery60")
		local dests = city and city:FindFirstChild("Destinations")
		local marker = dests and dests:FindFirstChild(activeDestinationId .. "_Marker")
		if root and marker then
			local d = (marker.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
			arrow.Text = ("📍 %s · %d"):format(tostring(activeDestinationName), math.floor(d))
		end
	end
	local char = player.Character
	local stab = char and char:GetAttribute("D60_Stability")
	if stab ~= nil then
		stabBar.Visible = true
		local frac = math.clamp(stab / STABILITY_MAX, 0, 1)
		stabFill.Size = UDim2.new(frac, -4, 1, -4)
	else
		stabBar.Visible = false
	end
end)

print("[Delivery60] Cliente listo · S1")
